steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Let's cook a warm, delicious bowl of tomato pasta!
Wash your hands first. Remember boiling water and bubbling pots must only be touched by a grown-up.
Here is our pasta, rich red tomato sauce, fragrant basil leaves, and grated cheese.
Carefully add the pasta into boiling water and cook until it is soft and tender.
Pour our warm red tomato sauce gently into the pot with the cooked pasta.
Stir everything smoothly with our spoon until every piece of pasta is coated in sauce.
Sprinkle freshly grated cheese and sweet basil leaves right on top.
Twirl the saucy tomato pasta gently onto our serving plate. Mangia, little chefs!
